about.title: About AW International
about.subtitle: Making clean water out of thin air
about.description: AW International pioneered atmospheric water generation technology for extracting water from humidity in the air. Drawing from the renewable ocean of water vapour in the air that we breathe, our patented technology cost effectively transforms humidity into an abundant source of clean water near the point of use.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Our mission is to provide pure bacteria free, clean, potable water throughout the world. Providing water for drinking, horticulture and agriculture and satisfy the thirst of the masses. Air-to-Water Generation will provide food for humanity during the threatening water crisis of the 21st century. Clean drinking water is among the world's most valuable commodities and is becoming increasingly limited; set to be a more valuable commodity than oil. WATER FOR THE WORLD.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: AWG International Inc. will continue to lead the pack on research and development in the field of Air-to-Water technology. The company's 2nd Generation water machines for home/office and commercial AquaMaX machines will set the industry standard, making AWG International Inc. the most recognised and trusted market leader in the world.

markets.title: Our Markets
markets.subtitle: Addressing the World's Water Crisis
markets.description: Of the total world water supply, approximately 97.5% is saltwater. Most of the remaining 2.5% is locked in ice and snow cover. Less than 1% of the earth's freshwater supply is available for use by the world's population.

crisis.title: Solving the World's Water Crisis
crisis.text1: By 2025, 1.8 billion people will be living in countries or regions with absolute water scarcity, and two thirds of the world's population could be living under water-stressed conditions.
crisis.text2: By 2030, 47% of the world's population will be living in areas of high water stress. Population will continue to grow. Water issues will become even more alarming.
crisis.oilGas: In addition to drinking water, the demand for water in industrial applications will continue to increase. For example, fracking activities in Texas consumed over 45 billion gallons of fresh water from January 2011 through May 2013.

1.title: Absorption
1.description: The system extracts humid air from the environment. Works with minimum humidity of 50%, no rain needed.

2.title: Condensation
2.description: Air is chilled to the dew point. Humidity condenses on state-of-the-art stainless steel coils.

3.title: Purification
3.description: Water passes through advanced filtration chambers, producing pure, clean drinking water ready for consumption.

1.question: What is Atmospheric Water Generation?
1.answer: Atmospheric water generation is a technology-based process used to condense water from the air, then capture and filter that moisture into drinkable water.

2.question: How does it work?
2.answer: AW International systems collect water from humidity in the atmosphere. This air is chilled to the 'dew point' and the moisture is condensed onto stainless steel or specially coated coils, then channeled through advanced filtering chambers to provide a reliable source of clean drinking water.

3.question: Under what environmental conditions can it produce water?
3.answer: AW International's technology will produce clean water effectively and economically from the air with humidity as low as 50%. Optimal water generation depends on average temperature and relative humidity. Higher humidity and temperature conditions improve cost effectiveness.

4.question: How pure is the water produced?
4.answer: The water produced is free of impurities, such as air pollution and metal oxide contamination. The advanced filtering process works all day and night, non-stop, maintaining an optimal level of purification. Water filtered has low TDS (Total Dissolved Solids).

5.question: How much water can be produced?
5.answer: Water production can range from up to five gallons/19 liters per day for household models, to more than 400 gallons/1,500 liters per day for commercial models, and even more through modular aggregation. With the AW 20K, more than 20,000 gallons/75,000 liters per day can be produced.

6.question: What does it take to operate and maintain?
6.answer: AW International systems are designed to operate continuously and only require modest periodic maintenance consisting of filter changes and general cleaning. Air filters should be replaced four to six times a year. Water filters should be replaced two to four times per year.
